Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with pain and
swelling of the left wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a distal radius fracture, and the
findings on examination and imaging clearly confirm the injury. The mechanism of
injury is consistent with the reported crash forces and the pattern of fracture seen.
No prior injury to the same area is known from the patient's history or records.
Initial management consisted of immobilization and analgesia, followed by a course of
supervised therapy. Over thirteen visits, the patient's range of motion, grip
strength, and pain levels improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced
accordingly as recovery progressed. Billing records reflect a standard sequence of
services, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. Treatment is considered to
have followed a typical clinical course. Discharge from active care is anticipated
once final functional assessment is complete.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
